question: What are the storage conditions for ImmunoChill Vaccine Vials?
reference_answer: 2°C to 8°C, protected from light, and must not be frozen. Optional: 12-month shelf life; the Vaccine Vial Monitor is checked at every handover.

question: Which documents must travel with every shipment?
reference_answer: A tax invoice, the Certificate of Analysis (CoA), the temperature log, and batch/expiry information.

question: What is ArcticLine's delivery window for dry-ice frozen shipments?
reference_answer: 36 hours. Optional: ArcticLine Cold Logistics is vendor V-003.

question: What has to happen if an ambient product stays above 30°C for 4 hours?
reference_answer: It must be reported to the warehouse supervisor, and QA issues a deviation report (rule: above 30°C for 4 or more continuous hours).

question: How often is temperature mapping of the cold rooms repeated?
reference_answer: Every 2 years.

question: Within how many days of delivery can a product be returned?
reference_answer: Within 30 days of delivery. Optional: returned products are quarantined and cannot be restocked without QA approval.

question: What quality rating does Deccan Pharma Logistics have?
reference_answer: B+ (audited Jan-2024).

question: What temperatures were recorded for SH-2024-004?
reference_answer: -22°C minimum and -18°C maximum, with no breach. Optional: TL-FROZ-7700 to GenPath Lab Bangalore.

question: Which product and batch were shipped in SH-2024-008, and who accepted it?
reference_answer: TL-COLD-9015 (ImmunoChill Vaccine Vials), batch BATCH-VAC-2406, 400 vials, accepted by Dr. Meena Joshi.

question: Who is the contact person for vendor V-004, and what is their email?
reference_answer: Imran Shaikh of SafeMove Transport Services, ops@safemove.in.

question: Which deviation report was raised for SH-2024-003?
Why was SH-2024-003 quarantined, and what corrective action followed?
reference_answer: It reached 11.2°C, exceeding the 10°C limit for 3 hours, because the PCM cold packs were not fully conditioned and a highway diversion added 4 hours of transit. CAPA: a mandatory 24-hour PCM conditioning checklist before loading and GPS route alerts for cold chain trucks.

question: Which vendor handled the rejected frozen shipment, and what is its on-time delivery rate?
reference_answer: ArcticLine Cold Logistics (V-003), which handled SH-2024-007; its FY2024 on-time delivery rate is 88%.

question: A cold-chain consignment arrived at 11°C. What must we do, and how fast?
reference_answer: Quarantine it immediately, notify QA within 2 hours, and do not release it until the QA investigation is complete (cold chain limit: above 10°C at any point).

question: What were the two temperature breaches in FY2024, and what did they have in common?
reference_answer: SH-2024-003 (cold chain, reached 11.2°C, quarantined) and SH-2024-007 (frozen, rose to -8°C, rejected). Both were temperature-sensitive products on multi-day transit whose thermal packaging was not matched to the actual transit duration.

question: A vendor shipment is more than 48 hours late. Who do we escalate to?
reference_answer: Level 3: escalate to the QA head at quality@nexachain-biomed.com with a written deviation. Optional: QA must also reassess product integrity before acceptance.

question: How long do the frozen sample kits stay usable?
reference_answer: 18 months shelf life from manufacture (TL-FROZ-7700, FreezeGuard Biological Sample Kit). Optional: must not be refrozen once thawed.

question: Do we have to keep the old logger calibration paperwork?
reference_answer: Yes: logger calibration certificates are retained for 3 years. Optional: loggers are calibrated every 6 months by an accredited lab.

question: Our truck broke down halfway to the customer. What now?
reference_answer: A backup validated vehicle must be dispatched within 6 hours. Notify the customer if the delay exceeds 24 hours, and QA must reassess product integrity if it exceeds 48 hours.

question: Which vendor has the best on-time delivery rate?
reference_answer: MedSupply India Pvt Ltd (V-001), with 96% in FY2024 (SafeMove 94%, Deccan 91%, ArcticLine 88%).

question: What fine do we pay if we break the storage rules?
reference_answer: The documents do not specify any fine for storage-rule violations. The only monetary penalty listed is a warning plus Rs. 5,000 for not updating the shipment log within 24 hours.

question: What was the temperature breach rate in Q3 FY2024?
reference_answer: The documents give no quarterly breach rate. Only the full-year figure exists: 20% (2 of 10 shipments). The incident report also says the rate fell within tolerance in the second half of the year, without a number.
